lines.t: Hatsune Miku has been to space. For real.

full.credit: Clips: Hatsune Miku official (Magical Mirai live) (YouTube)

lines.t: In May 2010, Japan launched a probe to Venus called Akatsuki. Fans sent in drawings and messages of Miku.

full.credit: Clips: Hatsune Miku official (Magical Mirai live) (YouTube)

lines.t: About 13,000 of them were printed onto metal plates, and attached to the probe.

full.credit: Clips: Hatsune Miku official (Magical Mirai live) (YouTube)

lines.t: It missed Venus, drifted for five years, then finally made it. Japan ended the mission in 2025.

full.credit: Clips: Hatsune Miku official (Magical Mirai live) (YouTube)
